visualReview.notes: Inspected all 77 fresh images across portable, shared-material/geographic-flat and current-Earth fixtures, including mode, detail and four-tier transition views. The three unequal curved flames retain distinct outward crowns and their signed north-hotel, south-residential and west-office arrangement. Current views show complete maintenance bands, shared podium, three stepped glazed pavilions, barrel atrium, roof pool, red cinema and supported hotel canopy. All four browser tiers were inspected; their deliberate faceting and plain opaque blue-grey glazing remain declared approximations. Existing attributed map rings and heading zero resolve the orientation; no new native hillside-grade claim is made. Corrected whole-building framing uses context scale 7; neighbor buildings and source-local height correction remain synthetic/approximate context. No new terrain, survey, reference-research or physical-device performance claim.

fidelityReview.notes: Read current HOK, Werner Sobek, CVU, Priedemann and Dlubal pages. Actually inspected cached HOK night exterior for silhouette and two completed engineer exterior images for daytime curves, maintenance bands and podium/arrival features. Cached HOK image0 is a security screen; both cached ArchDaily drawing images are ad/subscription screens and excluded. The cited facade paper currently404s, so no measured drawing inspection is claimed. HOK supplies south residential39storeys/north hotel36storeys/west office identity; CVU182/165/161m remain distinct from engineer approximate140/160/170m local above-ground heights and2008–2012 execution. Priedemann64,000m2/~120BMUdoors informs facade access concept, not pane pitch. Dlubal identical623ft tower claim is not used for heights. Original master reproduces sha256:a68a35dcd6d4a70289117247913290dd8a508d158c4e08af4e694656cbc329d5. Original68737triangles/7786092byte detailed master remains exactly reproducible through unchanged buildFlame recipe. Reviewed source retains original1.36m Hermite-sampled plan and original floor datums, curved pointed crowns, paired/partial dark maintenance slots, cut common podium, three stepped picture-window pavilions, curved roof pool, red cinema, glazed barrel atrium, hotel canopy and two cylindrical doors. Continuous atrium shell and merged frame strips reduce repeated pane islands; retained canopy/roof geometry closes the exterior. Skyline uses coarse wing sections and averaged shared graph colours with a continuous podium and closed stone pavilions, omitting fine maintenance slots, pavilion windows/skylights, vents and door framing. District restores dark maintenance bands, cut podium and pavilion windows; street restores facade sampling and sparse vent/joint sampling; close-up restores original facade/ring detail and entry hardware. Canonical limestone approximates concrete; coated-metal and one opaque palette-glass group retain three near draw groups with zero embedded images. Exact NURBS control points, hillside grading, section pitch, slot elevations and pavilion/entrance dimensions remain reconstructions; no surveyed terrain or physical-device-performance claim. Finite twelve-ray comparisons at six heights per tower use4/1.5/.5/.1m skyline/district/street/close-up along-ray allowances, excluding omitted fine trim; the804triangle ensemble skyline is deliberately coarser than the separately authored single-tower skylines. This is not a global Hausdorff bound. The merged branch changed model geometry since the previous approval. The current source generator/import reproduced the currently declared master bytes, all six GLBs were validated, and fresh portable, shared-material/geographic-flat and Earth-context images were inspected. Existing focused tests verify the current distinguishing geometry, signed footprint and browser budgets. The current review supersedes the previous geometry/hash approval; it does not claim unchanged GLBs relative to that older approval. Existing reference/placement scope remains explicit.
